metadata.title: Banana Flower and Fermented Fish Chutney
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/T0dUB

'Mekhin aro Nakham chutney' or Banana flower with fermented fish chutney is a classic and simple Garo chutney that commonly prepared in the Garo households as a side with meals be it lunch or dinner. This chutney has a certain umami taste to it. The roasted aroma of charcoal grilled banana flower mixed with pungency of fermented fish gives it the distinct umami flavour to it. It is a quick and easy dish to prepare.
